'''Turd Ferguson''' is the player name on three ''Star Wars'' CCG decklists from the [[2007 World Championship]]. Two are the Light and Dark Side lists from Day 2.<ref name="d2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2007/Worlds/2007+Worlds+D2.pdf 2007 Worlds Day 2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008203451/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2007/Worlds/2007+Worlds+D2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The third is a Light Side list from the Team event.<ref name="team">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2007/Worlds/2007+Worlds+Team.pdf 2007 Worlds Team.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008203555/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2007/Worlds/2007+Worlds+Team.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
